answer: Each submission hangs on the haven of a task receipt, and the oasis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the quill is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
